graph_policy: Retain directed source nonself multiedges, remove existing self loops and append exactly one per node; no reverse-edge insertion.

synthetic.generator: numpy.PCG64 with SeedSequence([seed, block_index]); fixed 65536-node blocks

training.split: uniform sample without replacement, sorted; independent permutation for benchmark order

cache_selection.gids: graph-based baseline selection pending, same 10% row budget
cache_selection.digit: independent profile frequency selection pending; do not fit to measured windows

reconstruction_choices: 19 classes, Adam lr=.001/weight_decay=.001/dropout=.2 are explicit untuned reconstruction choices, not paper-specified UKS settings.
Synthetic generator algorithm/seeds fixed here; old local labels/splits are not accepted.
Short windows measure real train steps including backward/optimizer; no accuracy, epoch-time, steady-state or convergence claim.
Final g2 count, graph edge count, GPU admission, cache selection and SSD map require actual preparation/validation.
UKS/UKL/CL have no supplied node features; local deterministic synthetic features are intentional dataset preparation. Generated data may use /mnt/n0; original graphs remain in /mnt/n3.
